# PIC16F (PIC12 baseline)

This page lists the PIC16F parts that use the PIC12 baseline core and that
`epic-cc` can target, for anyone picking a chip in this family.

| Part | Flash words | RAM bytes | EEPROM bytes | Status | Lifecycle | Datasheet |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PIC16F505 | 1024 | 72 | none | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/OTH/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/41236E.pdf) |
| PIC16F54 | 512 | 25 | none | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/OTH/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/41201B.pdf) |
| PIC16F57 | 2048 | 72 | none | experimental | Active | [datasheet](https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/OTH/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/41201B.pdf) |

## Notes

- RAM bytes counts what the compiler can allocate, not the datasheet total.
- Parts with `experimental` status compile, but are not yet checked by the
  project's own test matrix.
- The full list of parts is in the [device matrix](../index.md).

## Status

See [What's in 1.0](https://apojomovsky.github.io/epic-docs/status/) for this family's support level.
